name: PLATO AMPL-NLP Benchmark
description: Benchmarks nonlinear programming (NLP) solvers on 47 medium-scale instances specified in AMPL format, drawn from classical NLP test libraries. The benchmark compares local and global NLP solvers including interior-point, sequential quadratic programming (SQP), and augmented Lagrangian methods on continuous nonlinear problems with equality and inequality constraints.
typical_sota_score: COPT and KNITRO both solve 47/47 instances. COPT (1.0 scaled mean); UNO solves only 22/47. 2-hour time limit.
reputation: Standard NLP solver benchmark maintained by Hans Mittelmann; widely consulted in computational optimisation research.
notes: Not an LLM benchmark. AMPL source files publicly available. Geometric mean solution times range from 1.0 to 276 seconds across solvers.
